title: OpenCode
description: What Clank tells OpenCode of its model: how much of the engine's window is kept free for one step's tool results, so that OpenCode compacts a session before a step's results can make its next request too long for the engine.

context_margin.description: Tokens of the engine's window OpenCode is not told of, kept free for one step's tool results. OpenCode compacts a session once a step's total reaches the window it is told less its output limit; the step's tool results then go with the next request, which the engine refuses when it and the answer's room pass its window (262,144 less 16,384 less 16,384: OpenCode compacts at 229,376 tokens). The default holds one tool output as OpenCode cuts it (51,200 bytes or 2,000 lines) of code or prose, about 13,000 tokens; one of digits or a long listing can take up to 49,000, and several results in a step add up: then the gateway tells OpenCode the context was full, and OpenCode compacts. At most a quarter of the window is kept; 0 tells OpenCode the whole window. The Monitor shows the engine's window and the line OpenCode compacts at.
